narrative.title: Chapter 1 — The Signal
paras: Earth will be old and will die. The world will stay in a bad way. People need a new home.
One day, Era will get a call from Orion. It will be The Last Signal. The signal will go to Era.
Era will help the people. She will go to Orion.

narrative.title: Chapter 2 — The Fleet
paras: Era will meet a small group. Kai and Vega stay in the group. They want to leave Earth.
The group will have a plan. They will go far in Aurora. Other people go too.
Era will be well. She will have a friend on Aurora.

narrative.title: Chapter 3 — Leaving Earth
paras: The day will come. Aurora will leave Earth. The people look at the old world.
They go up and away. They move far from home. The way will seem long.
Era will look back at Earth. She will hope for a good future.

narrative.title: Chapter 4 — The Long Way
paras: They go for a long time. The people eat and talk. They learn to live on Aurora.
Kai will help with the work. Vega will tell a story at night. The group will stay together.
They wait and hope. The way will stay hard but they do not stop.

narrative.title: Chapter 5 — Edge of Orion
paras: At last they reach the far side of Orion. A big problem will come. The light will go out.
Aurora will move. The people feel bad. They do not know what to do.
Era will be strong. She will think of a way to help.

narrative.title: Chapter 6 — Working Together
paras: Kai and Vega join Era. The group will work as one team. They share one idea.
They make the light work. They use the old part. The work will stay hard but they do not stop.
At last the light will come back. The people feel good again.

narrative.title: Chapter 7 — New Home
paras: They see a new world. It will be a good place. Water will move all around.
The group will land on the new land. They build a small house. The young play and run.
Era will be well. She will know they will be home.

narrative.title: Chapter 8 — Rebuild
paras: The people start a new life. They grow food and share water. The town will grow.
Kai will help the young. Vega will keep the record. Era will lead the group.
The Last Signal will be a call for hope. Now the people live as one. The future will be good.
